melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.s.label: structural_snapshot
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.s.role: The phase 3-4 structural snapshot: value rows captured into the conduit cache bundle at conjure end and replayed at the next conjure when every owned spell still matches.
responsibilities: exports StructuralSnapshot, the capture, classification and replay helpers of the conjure-time structural cache

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.s.label: StructuralSnapshot
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.s.role: Slot-only static helper that captures each owned spell's phase 3-4 results as marshal-safe value rows and, on a full structural hit, replays them instead of running the structural phases.
responsibilities: builds one payload per owned spell at conjure end (capture_at_conjure_end, build_payload): the structural key (format, spell_id, binding hash, annotation type references), the world stamp, the replayable flag, phase-3 dependency ids and socket rows and the phase-4 validity and contract_unvalidated flag - values only, never index ids, objects or reprs
writes a socket row as the SpellSocketDescriptor fields in order - payload format 3 adds hidden_spell_ids and hidden_frame_keys (0.2.8281) - and rebuilds descriptors from rows (rebuild_topology)

stamps the world as a SHA-256 over the sorted pool ids with their binding hashes, the frame posture and the sorted borrowed ids with theirs (world_stamp); a pool holding an object or spellframe that overrides __eq__ is not replayable (pool_replayable, CompilerPhase3._eq_safe_object)

classifies each owned spell as a hit only when its payload is well-formed and carries the live key, the live world stamp and replayable True (classify, payload_well_formed): disabled, full_hit, partial or miss

on a full hit replays phase 3's durable writes through the registry helpers phase 3 calls, then the phase-4 verdict (hydrate_full_hit); capture is best-effort per spell, logs and drops a payload it cannot build and removes the payloads of spells no longer live, never raising into conjure
